    static void BFS_A(Coord s) {
        Queue<Coord> que = new LinkedList<>();
        int i = s.row, j = s.col;
        dist1[i][j] = 0;
        que.add(s);
        while (!que.isEmpty()) {
            Coord cur = que.poll();
            i = cur.row; j = cur.col;
            if (maze1[i][j] == 'Y') continue;
            if (i - 1 >= 0 && dist1[i - 1][j] > dist1[i][j] + 1) {
                dist1[i - 1][j] = dist1[i][j] + 1;
                que.add(new Coord(i - 1, j));
            }
            if (i + 1 < N && dist1[i + 1][j] > dist1[i][j] + 1) {

                }

            if (i - 1 >= 0 && dist2[i - 1][j] > dist2[i][j] + 1) {

                dist2[i][j + 1] = dist2[i][j] + 1;
                que.add(new Coord(i, j + 1));
            }
        }

    static int hopcroft(int total) {
        matchL = new int[total + 1];
        matchR = new int[total + 1];
        mark = new int[total + 1];
        Arrays.fill(matchL, -1);
        Arrays.fill(matchR, -1);
        boolean changed;
        while (true) {
            changed = false;
            Arrays.fill(mark, 0);
            for (int i = 1; i <= total; i++)
                if (matchR[i] == -1 && augment(i))
                    changed = true;
            if (!changed) break;
        }
        int ans = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= total; i++)
            if (matchR[i] != -1) ans++;
        return ans;
    }

    static boolean augment(int u) {
        if (mark[u] == 1) return false;
        mark[u] = 1;
        for (int v : edges[u]) {
            if (matchL[v] == -1) {
                matchL[v] = u;
                matchR[u] = v;
                return true;
            } else if (augment(matchL[v])) {
                matchL[v] = u;
                matchR[u] = v;
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
